title: Shipping times
body: Orders leave Demo Plant Shop within two working days. Delivery then takes three to five working days. We do not dispatch on weekends.

title: Shipping costs
body: Standard shipping costs 5 credits per order. Orders of 50 credits or more receive free standard shipping. These are fictional demo prices.

title: Delivery area
body: Demo Plant Shop delivers within the fictional Demo Region. International shipping is not available. Choose pickup if delivery is unavailable.

title: Tracking an order
body: A tracking reference appears in the order summary after dispatch. If it has not updated for five working days, use the help-center contact form. Do not include payment details.

title: Returning a plant
body: Request a return through the help-center contact form within 14 days of delivery. Keep the plant in its original pot and packaging. The support team explains the next steps before you send anything back.

title: Refund timing
body: Approved refunds are processed within five working days after the return is checked. The original payment method receives the refund. The payment service may take additional time to display it.

title: Damaged delivery
body: If a plant arrives damaged, contact support within two days of delivery. Include the order reference and a description of the damage. Keep the packaging until support replies.

title: Changing an order
body: Request an order change before dispatch using the help-center contact form. Include the order reference and requested change. Changes cannot be guaranteed once packing begins. For a different delivery address or recipient, request the change before dispatch; support confirms whether it is possible.

title: Cancelling an order
body: You can request cancellation before dispatch through the contact form. Once dispatched, follow the return process instead. Support confirms whether cancellation was possible.

title: Watering indoor plants
body: Check the top two centimeters of soil before watering. Water when that layer feels dry, then let excess water drain. Avoid leaving the pot in standing water.

title: Light for indoor plants
body: Most plants in the demo collection prefer bright indirect light. Avoid harsh midday sun on delicate leaves. Check the care card included with each plant for its individual needs.

title: Yellow leaves
body: Yellow leaves can have several causes, including too much water or too little light. Check soil moisture and the care card first. Ask support for help rather than changing several conditions at once.

title: Repotting
body: Check whether roots fill the pot before repotting. Choose a pot with drainage holes that is only slightly larger. Follow the plant care card for suitable soil.

title: Pet safety
body: Some plants are unsuitable for homes with pets. Check the care card before placing a plant near animals. If an animal eats a plant, seek professional veterinary advice.

title: Gift wrapping
body: Paper gift wrapping costs 2 demo credits per order. Select it before checkout. We cannot add wrapping after dispatch.

title: Gift messages
body: A short gift message can be added before checkout. Keep it under 150 characters. Gift messages are not printed on the outside of the parcel.

title: Pickup opening hours
body: The fictional Demo Plant Shop pickup point opens Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00–16:00. It is closed on Sunday and Monday. Wait for a ready-for-pickup notice before visiting.

title: Collecting an order
body: Bring your order reference after receiving the ready-for-pickup notice. Orders are held for seven days. Contact support if you need more time. For collection by another person, ask support to confirm the arrangement before visiting.

title: Contact support
body: Use the help-center contact form in the shop to reach support. The fictional team replies within two working days. This demo does not submit contact requests or collect personal details.

title: Unavailable plants
body: An unavailable plant cannot be ordered. Check the catalog again later for stock updates. The demo does not offer waiting lists or stock alerts.
